# Fixtures

Generated by `pnpm fixtures` into `repos/` (git-ignored). Deterministic authors and dates.

| Fixture | What it covers |
|---|---|
| `big-100k` | 100,000 commits, 1,999 merges, 20 tags; `src/hot.ts` touched every 20 commits (perf budgets) |
| `wide-100k` | 100,000 commits on 24 feature branches worked on in parallel (633 merges, all 24 still open); the graph's many-lane case (25 lanes) |
| `octopus` | 3-parent octopus merge; an orphan root merged with `--allow-unrelated-histories` |
| `renames` | a file renamed twice with edits; a block moved to another file (blame `-C`) |
| `shallow` | depth-3 clone of `renames` |
| `partial` | `--filter=blob:none` clone of `renames` |
| `worktrees` | linked worktree on a branch (`worktrees-feature`) and a detached one (`worktrees-detached`) |
| `revisions-500` | one file with 500 revisions |
| `large-files` | a 20k-line file and a binary file |
| `small` | 5 commits, a merged branch; the integration-test workspace |

`conflicts` holds the 12 conflict scenarios of the M4 gate. Each has branches `<name>-base`, `<name>-ours` and
`<name>-theirs` touching only its own files; the test merges `-theirs` into `-ours` (`m-*`) or rebases `-theirs`
onto `-ours` (`r-*`), with `merge.conflictStyle` set as the name says:

| Scenario | Operation | Conflict |
|---|---|---|
| `m-simple` / `r-simple` | merge / rebase | one changed line, both sides |
| `m-multi` / `r-multi` | merge / rebase | three separate hunks (changes 10 lines apart in a 24-line file) |
| `m-diff3` / `r-diff3` | merge / rebase | one hunk, `diff3` style (base section) |
| `m-zdiff3` | merge | two-line hunk, `zdiff3` style |
| `m-delete-modify` / `r-delete-modify` | merge / rebase | ours edits a file theirs deletes |
| `m-rename-rename` | merge | each side renames the same file differently |
| `m-binary` / `r-binary` | merge / rebase | both sides change a binary file |

Rebase rename/rename and rebase zdiff3 are left out: the same code paths as their merge forms.
